excluded: Finite one-peer Ethernet IPv4 UDP/Echo plus inherited ARP/transmit only; no TCP/full endpoint
No routing/multipeer/fragments/options/PMTU/ICMP errors/client/general sockets; no live composed ingress evidence

ENDPOINT-INGRESS.interpretation: Finite fixed-link profile; full frame bounds/canonical padding checked before raw IP slice; ingress does not learn ARP or alter queued TX.

ENDPOINT-LINK.interpretation: Ethernet IPv4 type0800; padding excluded from IP length/checksum. Canonical extent is finite profile policy, arbitrary input pad ignored and output zero padded.

UDPRX-RX-PROFILE.interpretation: Preserve existing raw component policy within explicitly checked fixed Ethernet ingress envelope; independent module variables; three inherited ARP states.

UDPRX-IP-LENGTH.interpretation: IPv4 Total Length includes header and data; this raw-entry profile requires exact datagram bytes.

UDPRX-IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify each admitted fixed IPv4 header; invalid checksum silently discards.

UDPRX-UDP-LENGTH.interpretation: UDP length includes eight-byte header and data; surplus beyond UDP length remains out of scope.

UDPRX-UDP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Discard invalid nonzero checksum; optionally discard absent checksum. This profile defaults to allowing absent checksums.

UDPRX-UDP-PSEUDO.interpretation: Checksum covers pseudoheader with IP addresses/protocol/UDP length plus UDP header/data. Zero means absent; FFFF validates normally.

UDPRX-IP-ATOMIC-ID.interpretation: Only DF1/MF0/offset0 packets: ignore arbitrary ID for admission/duplicate semantics; original ID octets remain checked by the IPv4 checksum.

ECHO-ECHO-PROFILE.interpretation: Preserve existing raw component policy within explicitly checked fixed Ethernet ingress envelope; independent module variables; three inherited ARP states.

ECHO-ECHO-REPLY.interpretation: Reverse addresses, type0/code0, unchanged identifier/sequence and all data; recompute checksum including odd zero pad for arithmetic only.

ECHO-ECHO-HOST.interpretation: Echo server and same specific-destination source/data preservation, within declared unicast profile only.

ECHO-IP-LENGTH.interpretation: Exact raw datagram length in this nonfragmented IHL5 profile.

ECHO-IP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Verify IPv4 header checksum and silently discard invalid datagram.

ECHO-ICMP-CHECKSUM.interpretation: Validate ones-complement checksum over complete ICMP message; no UDP absent/zero remapping. Invalid admitted message silently discarded by profile policy.

ECHO-IP-ATOMIC.interpretation: DF1/MF0/off0: input ID ignored for semantics but checked by checksum; output atomic ID0 profile choice.
